title: Scottish Highlands launch 100-year project to revive lost forests, wetlands and wildlife
summary_full: The Scottish Highlands are undergoing a 100-year restoration project led by the Durrell Wildlife Conservation Trust to revive lost forests, wetlands and wildlife. Covering a 7,500-hectare estate in the Cairngorms National Park, the initiative aims to reverse centuries of environmental damage through peatland restoration, native tree planting and scientific monitoring for future generations.
